line: Good morning. Ten reps, one call each. First up, Randy. Twenty-one calls read, sixteen set. Today's call is booked, but fragile: bill capture without emotional flip. The call opens on a wrong-name stumble and spends its middle stretch fielding a customer who keeps trying to get the proposal sent to him. Here's the moment, at four fifty-three.

candidates.description: Male, mid-40s, American, calm and unhurried, low register, warm but direct. A seasoned sales manager reviewing the morning's calls with a rep he respects. Conversational, no announcer polish.
